=== sheet 'Notes'
A2='As transcribed by Peter Lindert, May 2006, using'
A3='Liu, Guanglin William, "Wrestling for Power: The State and the Economy'
A4='in Later Imperial China, 1000-1770." Doctoral dissertation, Harvard University, 2005.'
A6='For Kishimoto series:'
A7='Source: Table 3.1, p.115 in Mio Kishimoto, Price and Economic Changes in Qing China (in Japanese). Tokyo: Kenbun Publishing, 1997. '
A9='For Peng series:'
A10='Source: Peng Xinwei, p. 459 in Monetary History of China Quanlian Publishing, Shanghai: 1957.'
A12='According to Liu, Guanglin William, "Wrestling for Power: The State and the Economy'
A13='in Later Imperial China, 1000-1770." Doctoral dissertation, Harvard University, 2005,   '
A14='1 Ming tael = 36.9 grams of silver, and 1 Qing tael = 37.3 grams of silver.  '
A16='One shi equaled 107.3 liters in the Ming dynasty, and 103.5 liters in the Qing, according to Kang Chao, '
A17='Man and Land in Chinese History (Stanford: Stanford University Press, 1986), Appendix A.'
A18='Lin gives 100 liters for both Ming and Qing.  The conversions on these worksheets use the Kang Chao liter/shi ratios.  '
